# Original Actor-Pass Projection

The manifest authenticates unchanged LEZAC.EXE, every producer module, the
actual mapped Unicorn 2.1.4 library and both projection representations.
The gzip member expands to exactly 35,707,847 bytes.

The 876 controlled cases execute from the actual 7EBB caller through boss,
nonplayer and both-player work to 804E, restart or a terminal fault boundary.
No later state is seeded at a handoff. Full register traces and ordered writes
are replayed against one borrowed memory bus and stack.

This is not a natural route, production-App comparison, delivered original IRQ
schedule or whole-frame fidelity claim. Full RAM images and screenshots are
not included. See docs/recovery/frame-actor-pass-20261020.md for evidence,
scope, cross-actor observations and validation.

The current manifest also binds the bounded failure-report helper. The producer
retains only hashes, registers and short diagnostic tails on failure, never a
full guest RAM dump. Regeneration after that repair is byte-identical to the
original compressed projection; the source-catalog binding alone changed.
